answers.q1_what_did_you_play: I played Rapid Fire on Nibbit for 0, consuming the 3 Sparks; then Kaboom! on Nibbit for its printed cost of 1; then Duck and Cover for 1. This deals 23 damage and gains 5 Block.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered replacing Duck and Cover with Eager to Help, keeping the same 23 damage while drawing two cards.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up drawing two cards in exchange for 5 Block against the telegraphed 12-damage attack.
answers.q4_different_intent: Yes. If Nibbit had telegraphed no attack, I would have replaced Duck and Cover with Eager to Help.
